_about: Thomas Cranmer (1489-1556), Archbishop of Canterbury. The target is the Parker Society edition, ed. John Edmund Cox (2 vols, Cambridge 1844-1846), Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each volume's title page read before listing. No Gutenberg Cranmer exists; CCEL holds only a 922-word fragment of A Necessary Doctrine (excluded).

cranmer-ps-01: Writings and Disputations of Thomas Cranmer relative to the Sacrament of the Lord's Supper, ed. J. E. Cox (Parker Society, Cambridge, 1844), vol. 1
cranmer-ps-02: Miscellaneous Writings and Letters of Thomas Cranmer, ed. J. E. Cox (Parker Society, Cambridge, 1846), vol. 2

_alternates.theworksofthomas01cramuoft, theworksofth: Second Toronto copy of the same two volumes.
